title: Debunking Myths related to Table Structure in Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 Wave 2
summary: This post debunks common myths about table structure limits in Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 Wave 2 (version 29), which now merges table extension fields into base tables. It clarifies field count limits (1018 fields), SQL Server 8KB record size constraints based on data types, key/index limits (no 40-key cap), and the possibility of mixing base and extension fields in indexes.
key_points: In version 29, all third-party app fields are now part of the base table with no separate table extension joins
Maximum of 1018 regular fields can be defined in a table (1024 SQL columns minus 6 system fields)
The 8KB SQL Server limit applies only to primitive data types; text and code fields use pointers and can exceed this
The 40-key limit from CSIDE no longer applies; SQL Server allows up to 999 indexes
Base table fields and extension fields can be mixed in the same index, with some constraints across different apps

quotes.text: All 3rd party app fields are now part of the base table.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is a fundamental architectural change in version 29 that affects how developers design and extend tables

quotes.why_it_matters: Understanding the SQL Server hard limit helps developers plan field counts without hitting deployment errors

quotes.text: Text and Code they don't. They are SQL NVARCHAR, hence their data can be of super large dimension.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that the 8KB record limit is conditional on data type, not an absolute constraint for all fields
